assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
service is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that are not captured on standard monitoring
directly supporting the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation
